questions.stem: Why is forced ventilation useful inside a spacecraft in microgravity?
options: Buoyancy-driven convection becomes stronger in free fall
Natural buoyancy-driven convection is greatly reduced
Heat cannot be exchanged between air and cabin equipment
Fans function only when installed outside the spacecraft
questions.explanation: Without normal buoyancy-driven convection, fans can help circulate cabin air.

questions.stem: Why can long exposure to microgravity affect astronauts?
options: The body is exposed to greater weight-bearing loads throughout the stay
Gravity disappears completely throughout Earth orbit
Reduced loading can contribute to muscle and bone loss
Only equipment, not the human body, changes in microgravity
questions.explanation: Reduced mechanical loading can contribute to muscle and bone loss; exercise helps mitigate these effects.

questions.stem: What is the role of a tether attachment during an external spacewalk?
options: Supply breathing gas through the attachment itself
Automatically dock the spacecraft with a station
Produce independent manoeuvring thrust for the astronaut
Help prevent the astronaut or tools drifting away from the spacecraft
questions.explanation: Tethers and attachment points help keep crew and equipment connected during an EVA.

questions.stem: What can happen to some materials exposed to the vacuum of space?
options: Material can outgas or sublime
Materials react with abundant surrounding atmospheric oxygen
Materials condense liquid water from the surrounding vacuum
External pressure rises until it equals cabin pressure
questions.explanation: Vacuum may promote outgassing or sublimation in susceptible materials.

questions.stem: Which combination is used to reduce radiation risk during a mission?
options: Mission planning removes any need to consider shielding
Shielding and mission planning
Thermal insulation always provides equivalent radiation shielding
Solar panels alone prevent particle radiation exposure
questions.explanation: Shielding and planning around the radiation environment help reduce exposure and damage.

questions.stem: Why can repeated changes between sunlight and shadow stress a spacecraft?
options: Thermal expansion cannot occur in vacuum
An eclipse always heats the exterior surface
Temperature changes can cause differential expansion and contraction
Exterior temperature remains constant without thermal management
questions.explanation: Temperature changes can create thermal deformation and stress in materials and joints.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of a radioisotope thermoelectric generator?
options: Convert sunlight directly through photovoltaic cells
Convert stored electricity solely into heat
Use a fuel and oxidizer reaction as its primary source
Convert part of radioactive decay heat into electrical power
questions.explanation: An RTG converts some heat from radioactive decay into electricity through thermoelectric elements.

questions.stem: Which statement describes water recycling for crew life support?
options: It can reduce resupply needs but does not recover everything perfectly
It guarantees a completely closed water loop in every condition
It produces potable water without treatment or energy
It is used only when resupply is physically impossible
questions.explanation: Water recovery reduces demand for resupply, but recycling systems have losses and operational limits.

questions.stem: How can a life-support system produce oxygen from stored water?
options: Recover oxygen solely by absorbing carbon dioxide
By electrolysis of water
Convert nitrogen into oxygen by compression
Extract atmospheric oxygen from the surrounding vacuum
questions.explanation: Electrolysis separates water into hydrogen and oxygen using electrical energy.

questions.stem: Why do global navigation satellite systems account for relativistic effects?
options: Satellite and ground clocks run at identical rates in every orbit
Relativistic corrections affect only propellant consumption
Motion and gravity change clock rates by different amounts
Knowing the satellite position makes precise timing unnecessary
questions.explanation: Satellite motion and the different gravitational field affect clock rates, so precise navigation must account for both.
